sentences.en: An emerging discipline called neuroaesthetics is seeking to bring scientific objectivity to the study of art, and has already given us a better understanding of many masterpieces.
sentences.zh: 一门名为神经美学的新兴学科正在寻求为艺术研究带来科学客观性,并且已经让我们对许多杰作有了更好的理解。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The blurred imagery of Impressionist paintings seems to stimulate the brain's amygdala, for instance.
sentences.zh: 例如,印象派绘画的模糊图像似乎会刺激大脑的杏仁核。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Since the amygdala plays a crucial role in our feelings, that finding might explain why many people find these pieces so moving.
sentences.zh: 由于杏仁核在我们的感受中起着至关重要的作用,这一发现可能解释了为什么许多人觉得这些作品如此感人。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Could the same approach also shed light on abstract twentieth-century pieces, from Mondrian's geometrical blocks of colour, to Pollock's seemingly haphazard arrangements of splashed paint on canvas?
sentences.zh: 同样的方法是否也能揭示二十世纪的抽象作品,从蒙德里安的几何色块,到波洛克在画布上看似随意的泼漆布置？

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Sceptics believe that people claim to like such works simply because they are famous.
sentences.zh: 怀疑论者认为,人们声称喜欢此类作品只是因为它们出名。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: We certainly do have an inclination to follow the crowd.
sentences.zh: 我们确实有随波逐流的倾向。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: When asked to make simple perceptual decisions such as matching a shape to its rotated image, for example, people often choose a definitively wrong answer if they see others doing the same.
sentences.zh: 例如,当被要求做出简单的感知决策（例如将形状与其旋转图像相匹配）时,如果人们看到其他人也在做同样的事情,他们通常会选择绝对错误的答案。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: It is easy to imagine that this mentality would have even more impact on a fuzzy concept like art appreciation, where there is no right or wrong answer.
sentences.zh: 不难想象,这种心态对于像艺术欣赏这样没有正确或错误答案的模糊概念会产生更大的影响。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Angelina Hawley-Dolan, of Boston College, Massachusetts, responded to this debate by asking volunteers to view pairs of paintings either the creations of famous abstract artists or the doodles of infants, chimps and elephants.
sentences.zh: 马萨诸塞州波士顿学院的安吉丽娜·霍利-多兰回应了这一争论,要求志愿者观看成对的绘画作品,要么是著名抽象艺术家的作品,要么是婴儿、黑猩猩和大象的涂鸦。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: They then had to judge which they preferred.
sentences.zh: 然后他们必须判断他们更喜欢哪个。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: A third of the paintings were given no captions, while many were labelled incorrectly - volunteers might think they were viewing a chimp's messy brushstrokes when they were actually seeing an acclaimed masterpiece.
sentences.zh: 三分之一的画作没有标题,而许多画作的标签也不正确——志愿者可能会认为他们看到的是黑猩猩凌乱的笔触,而实际上他们看到的是一幅广受好评的杰作。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: In each set of trials, volunteers generally preferred the work of renowned artists, even when they believed it was by an animal or a child.
sentences.zh: 在每组试验中,志愿者通常更喜欢著名艺术家的作品,即使他们认为这是动物或儿童的作品。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: It seems that the viewer can sense the artist's vision in paintings, even if they can't explain why.
sentences.zh: 观众似乎可以在绘画中感受到艺术家的视觉,即使他们无法解释为什么。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Robert Pepperell, an artist based at Cardiff University, creates ambiguous works that are neither entirely abstract nor clearly representational.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特·佩珀雷尔 (Robert Pepperell) 是卡迪夫大学的一位艺术家,他创作的作品既不完全抽象,也不具有明显的代表性。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: In one study, Pepperell and his collaborators asked volunteers to decide how 'powerful' they considered an artwork to be, and whether they saw anything familiar in the piece.
sentences.zh: 在一项研究中,佩珀雷尔和他的合作者要求志愿者决定他们认为一件艺术品的“力量”有多大,以及他们是否在这件作品中看到了任何熟悉的东西。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The longer they took to answer these questions, the more highly they rated the piece under scrutiny, and the greater their neural activity.
sentences.zh: 他们回答这些问题的时间越长,他们对审查的作品的评价就越高,他们的神经活动就越强。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: It would seem that the brain sees these images as puzzles, and the harder it is to decipher the meaning, the more rewarding is the moment of recognition.
sentences.zh: 大脑似乎将这些图像视为谜题,破译其含义越困难,识别的时刻就越有价值。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: And what about artists such as Mondrian, whose paintings consist exclusively of horizontal and vertical lines encasing blocks of colour?
sentences.zh: 那么像蒙德里安这样的艺术家呢？他们的画作完全由包围色块的水平和垂直线条组成？

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: Mondrian's works are deceptively simple, but eye-tracking studies confirm that they are meticulously composed, and that simply rotating a piece radically changes the way we view it.
sentences.zh: 蒙德里安的作品看似简单,但眼球追踪研究证实它们是精心构图的,并且简单地旋转一件作品就可以从根本上改变我们观看它的方式。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: With the originals, volunteers' eyes tended to stay longer on certain places in the image, but with the altered versions, they would flit across a piece more rapidly.
sentences.zh: 在原始版本中,志愿者的眼睛往往会在图像中的某些位置停留更长时间,但在修改后的版本中,他们会更快地掠过图像。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: As a result, the volunteers considered the altered versions less pleasurable when they later rated the work.
sentences.zh: 因此,志愿者在后来对作品进行评分时认为修改后的版本不太令人愉快。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: In a similar study, Oshin Vartanian of Toronto University asked volunteers to compare original paintings with ones which he had altered by moving objects around within the frame.
sentences.zh: 在一项类似的研究中,多伦多大学的 Oshin Vartanian 要求志愿者将原画与他通过在画框内移动物体而改变的画作进行比较。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: He found that almost everyone preferred the original, whether it was a Van Gogh still life or an abstract by Miró.
sentences.zh: 他发现几乎每个人都更喜欢原作,无论是梵高的静物画还是米罗的抽象画。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Vartanian also found that changing the composition of the paintings reduced activation in those brain areas linked with meaning and interpretation.
sentences.zh: Vartanian 还发现,改变绘画的构图会减少与意义和解释相关的大脑区域的激活。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: In another experiment, Alex Forsythe of the University of Liverpool analysed the visual intricacy of different pieces of art, and her results suggest that many artists use a key level of detail to please the brain.
sentences.zh: 在另一项实验中,利物浦大学的 Alex Forsythe 分析了不同艺术作品的视觉复杂性,她的结果表明许多艺术家使用关键的细节水平来取悦大脑。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Too little and the work is boring, but too much results in a kind of 'perceptual overload, according to Forsythe. What's more, appealing pieces both abstract and representational, show signs of 'fractals' - repeated motifs recurring in different scales.
sentences.zh: 太少了,工作就会很无聊,但太多会导致一种“知觉超载”,福赛斯说。更重要的是,吸引人的抽象和具象作品都显示出“分形”的迹象——以不同尺度重复出现的重复图案。

grammar.type: 分词结构 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Fractals are common throughout nature, for example in the shapes of mountain peaks or the branches of trees.
sentences.zh: 分形在自然界中很常见,例如山峰或树枝的形状。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: It is possible that our visual system, which evolved in the great outdoors, finds it easier to process such patterns.
sentences.zh: 我们的视觉系统可能是在户外进化的,因此更容易处理这些模式。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: It is also intriguing that the brain appears to process movement when we see a handwritten letter, as if we are replaying the writer's moment of creation.
sentences.zh: 同样有趣的是,当我们看到一封手写的信件时,大脑似乎会处理运动,就好像我们正在重播作家的创作时刻一样。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: This has led some to wonder whether Pollock's works feel so dynamic because the brain reconstructs the energetic actions the artist used as he painted.
sentences.zh: 这让一些人怀疑波洛克的作品是否感觉如此充满活力,因为大脑重建了艺术家在绘画时使用的充满活力的动作。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: This may be down to our brain's 'mirror neurons, which are known to mimic others' actions.
sentences.zh: 这可能归因于我们大脑的“镜像神经元”,众所周知,它们会模仿他人的行为。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: The hypothesis will need to be thoroughly tested, however.
sentences.zh: 然而,该假设需要经过彻底检验。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: It might even be the case that we could use neuroaesthetic studies to understand the longevity of some pieces of artwork.
sentences.zh: 我们甚至可以利用神经美学研究来了解某些艺术品的寿命。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: While the fashions of the time might shape what is currently popular, works that are best adapted to our visual system may be the most likely to linger once the trends of previous generations have been forgotten.
sentences.zh: 虽然时代的时尚可能会影响当前的流行,但一旦前几代的趋势被遗忘,最适合我们视觉系统的作品可能最有可能留存下来。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: It's still early days for the field of neuroaesthetics and these studies are probably only a taste of what is to come.
sentences.zh: 神经美学领域还处于早期阶段,这些研究可能只是未来的一个尝试。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: It would, however, be foolish to reduce art appreciation to a set of scientific laws.
sentences.zh: 然而,将艺术欣赏简化为一套科学定律是愚蠢的。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: We shouldn't underestimate the importance of the style of a particular artist, their place in history and the artistic environment of their time.
sentences.zh: 我们不应该低估特定艺术家的风格、他们在历史中的地位以及他们所处时代的艺术环境的重要性。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Abstract art offers both a challenge and the freedom to play with different interpretations.
sentences.zh: 抽象艺术既提供了挑战,也提供了尝试不同解释的自由。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: In some ways, it's not so different to science, where we are constantly looking for systems and decoding meaning so that we can view and appreciate the world in a new way.
sentences.zh: 在某些方面,它与科学没有太大不同,我们不断寻找系统和解码意义,以便我们能够以新的方式看待和欣赏世界。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。
